title: The concentration game: Bayesian updating, regret, and information
abstract: arXiv:2608.18061v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We give a two-player zero-sum repeated game between a learner and nature whose value identity generates Bayesian updating and an exact accounting of exponential-weights regret at once, and supplies the comparator-class variational form that a wide class of concentration phenomena share. The terminal payoff is the most a comparator can gain at fixed relative entropy from the prior, and the one-step constraint is an information budget on nature's move under the learner's mixed action. With the learner's move otherwise unrestricted, Gibbs/Bayes weights emerge as its unique Bellman equalizer -- the mixed action that makes the per-round loss independent of which direction nature moves -- with log-partition functions playing the role of value functions. translated_title: 集中博弈：贝叶斯更新、遗憾与信息
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.18061v1 公告类型：新 摘要：我们给出了一个学习者和自然之间的两人零和重复博弈，其价值恒等式同时生成贝叶斯更新和指数权重遗憾的精确核算，并提供了广泛浓度现象所共有的比较器类变分形式。终端收益是固定相对熵下比较器相对于先验的最大收益，一步约束是在学习者混合行动下自然移动的信息预算。在学习者行动不受其他限制的情况下，吉布斯/贝叶斯权重作为其独特的贝尔曼均衡器出现——即使得每轮损失独立于自然移动方向的混合行动——其中对数配分函数扮演价值函数的角色。遗憾精确分解为三个部分：反映观测结果变异的每轮信息损失、精确核算任何变化加性重调温漂移，以及...
tldr: 本文提出一种零和博弈框架，统一了贝叶斯更新与指数权重遗憾，并揭示了浓度现象的变分形式，其核心贡献在于将信息预算与贝尔曼均衡结合，给出遗憾的精确三部分分解。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a zero-sum game framework unifying Bayesian updating and exponential-weights regret, revealing a variational form for concentration phenomena, with the key contribution of combining information budgets with Bellman equalization to yield an exact three-part regret decomposition.
